heading: From prompt to merged PR, atom by atom.
description: Helix turns every coding task into a directed acyclic graph of small, reviewable units — then executes them in order with verification gates between each step.

steps.title: Describe the goal
steps.description: Tell Helix what you want to build. It accepts natural-language prompts, ticket links, or diffs to extend.
bullets: Prompt or ticket in, plan out

steps.title: Decompose into atoms
steps.description: Helix breaks the goal into atomic work units with explicit dependencies. Each atom is small enough to review in under five minutes.
bullets: Each atom is a single concern

steps.title: Apply, review, merge
steps.description: Parallel agents implement each atom; Helix gates execution on dependencies and verifies the result against types, tests, and lint before opening the PR.

steps.title: Ship with confidence
steps.description: Every atom lands as its own PR with full provenance — what changed, why, and which gates it passed. Roll back any atom without touching the rest.
